The session was mostly efficient: 13 turns, no failures, no writes, no shell use, and the peak context was about 26k tokens. The one weak spot is three overlapping searches for the same terms. The final reply is cut off in the view I have, so I can't confirm it ends with the required `ARTIFACT gap_finding:` line or stays within 1,500 characters.

- **Overlapping searches (turns 4, 5, 7):** The session ran three greps for nearly the same terms (stamp, diagram, authoring record, authoring.json). The first returned only 16 characters, so it found almost nothing. Turn 7 largely repeated turn 5. A single combined search would have done the job. The cost is small.
- **Stamp read versus the answer (turns 8, 12, 13):** Turn 12 read `plugins/release-notes-tgraph/stamp.json`, an existing stamp. Turn 13 opens by saying nothing declares regenerations for this repository. That may be accurate, because the commands file only holds verification commands, but the session never shows how the stamp relates to the declaration the gap asks about. The reply is truncated, so I can't tell whether it covers this.
